title: Docs Identity Hashing
objective: Replace volatile verified-documentation example IDs with content-addressed source-path/input/output identities while retaining line provenance and deterministic verification artifacts

oracles: Focused identity stability and invalidation tests

handoff.summary: Verified documentation examples now use source-path plus normalized input/output SHA-256 addresses while retaining line and extractor coordinate provenance. Identical repeated transcripts receive deterministic occurrence suffixes.
risks: Occurrence suffixes depend on the relative order of exact duplicate transcripts within one source path; distinct examples remain independently content-addressed.
next_steps: Add test/reference-examples.cjs to test/node-test-manifest.cjs in the integration lane.
